But place quite large -about 100 tables so getting to the raw food material to cook is quite a way to go if not seated towards center.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Daniel L
review_text: Huge assortment of seafood and meat options. Indoor seating is warm, outdoor seating is cooler but is not shaded. 498 baht per pax for access to all seafood and meat options. Grilled whole fish, horseshoe crab roe salad among the selections. Seafood were all fresh.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Valentino Tan
review_text:
what i like about this place is i can choose my own fish and let them cooked the style that is being offered.
Theres 20 options for a variety of seafood, fish, prawns, shells.

big fat prawn and fish
theres 2 charcoal pot, one for grilled one mookata style.
the salt fish with lemongrass inside is nice.
this place good as i can smoke. its in the open

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Leia
review_text:
We arrived at 4:30 PM and found several vans already there. This is an open-air restaurant without air conditioning.

The seafood buffet is priced at THB498 per adult and THB198 per kid.

The sheer variety of food is overwhelming. The seafood is fresh. You have three options: order and have it cooked for you, choose from their ready-to-eat dishes, or grill the food yourself.

There's no time limit for dining. Worth to try it.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Joey Ng
review_text: Best of both worlds, where local Thai style dishes and Thai mookata can be experienced in one location. Seafood choices was plentiful, styles of cooking was variable too. Choose to grill or Mookata your way through the extensive food choices of meat and seafood or pick your choice for them to cook up a pretty legit Thai style dish. Side dishes, local dessert, ice cream, fruits and drinks choices were awesome too. THB 498 per pax is such an awesome deal, with Eat All You Can No Time Limit. Only suggestion for improvement is the condition of their chairs which can be improved in terms of cleanliness. Plenty of parking.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Toto Ong
review_text: Fully recommended moo-ka-taa buffet with exquisite seafood selection like a seafood market. 498baht per person with unlimited time. Must come early to take your Q number. Plenty of car park provided.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Eric TJF
review_text:
One of the famous all-you-can-eat buffet in Hatyai with seafood package priced at only 498 thai baht per person.
Accept Malaysia national QR payment method as well; easy and convenient, no cash is required 👍
Be sure to be at here earlier during weekends as it's quite pack

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Katrina Felix
review_text:
Nice food, worth the price. It’s naturally ventilated so it can be warm. Seafood all fresh. There’s a combination of cooking it yourself and selecting the seafood and the restaurant cooking it for you. Either way , all delicious.

I forgot to take the fresh uncooked seafood but you can see from all the photos shared on google reviews- still the same now.

I recommend you give it a try when you’re in Hatyai!

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Ong Lieh Yan
review_text:
Seafood galore!!! Fresh seafood everywhere and many types to choose from too. Was impressed with some fresh big sized fishes there. Even the bigger sized squids are available. Meaty section is there too. Provided with one Thai hotpot and a charcoal grill. You can cook your own or ask them to cook for you. Desserts from shaved ice to ice cream. Definitely a must-go to place when you are in Hat Yai.
My personal recommendation: Go for the seafood AND most important ask them to cook!! 😀

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Yenestc Lim
review_text: This is super nice experience! Variety of choice, pork leg very nice, seafood very fresh, non stop to top up from staff! Need to book in advance for better reserve of table! Worth with money gave!

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Cher Ong
review_text: Very spacious area for seafood buffet & mookota. I'm here just for the cooked seafood as I'm too lazy to bbq it on my own. It's way more convenient & save the work and heat. There are a lot of seafood variations & other side items. Dessert, salad & drinks are also available. It's definitely worth the money even if you're not with a big appetite.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Peekaboo
review_text:
Eat all you can!! Great choices of fresh seafood and meat!! For tourists you will be offered many local Thais cuisine, so eat all you can! Make sure you bring empty stomach so its worth your money 🤩🤩
They offer payment via both cash and QR (non Thai can use TnG etc)

Toilets can be improved 🙂🙂

author: Notorious
review_text: Trying Bingsu for the first time, and what better place than the country where it originated. The shaved ice is cooling and refreshing, and you can adjust the sweetness yourself with the syrup provided. The café itself is cozy and clean, though the outdoor tent seating isn’t particularly impressive. A highlight for me was the friendly cat lounging out front 🐱, which added a bit of charm to the visit.

author: Kenson Luk
review_text: Best shaved ice I have ever had. I got the Thai milk tea bingsu. It had 3 kinds of bubbles and croutons inside, whip cream and sliced almonds, the ice was very soft and light.

author: Yee Sheng Kwan
review_text: FANTASTIC!! The best Bingsu I had tried ever. Really impressive 🔥 Good photo and good desserts! Jackson Wang must try thiss!

author: Chin Yan
review_text: The details they put into the deco and the food is spectacular. Recommended to be there during brunch, crowd starts around 1-2pm. Got the salted egg coconut bingsoo, unsure of the original name. Hint of saltiness but sweet. Free parking available here.

author: aqilah yahya
review_text: This café is aesthetically beautiful—cute and sleek. It has a nice ambiance, making it a great spot to hang out and take photos. The food is delicious, the service is excellent, and we didn’t have to wait for a table. My friends and I had a great time here.

author: May Choo
review_text:
Same taste as the original branch in Chiangmai! I've ordered the Earl grey bingsoo that came with boba. As it's not that sweet, I pretty love its taste. The bingsoo is very mellow and smooth. Adding sweet boba is a great combo.
The staff can also communicate in multi languages. However, it's super crowded at lunch time.

author: W T
review_text: Portions are big, and the desserts taste alright—my companion enjoyed them. We had the Thai tea bingsu and panda coconut toast with a lemon tea. The total came to about 580 baht.

author: Leanna
review_text:
I love everything about this place. The food, service and the atmosphere, everything is great!
Nothing to complain and totally worth the hype!

We chose the typical thai’s specialty; sangkaya & mango.
The mango ice shave is so sooo good! Not too sweet. And the mango is not too ripe. So, it was a bit sour and it compliments the sweetness from the ice.

And their sangkaya toast also so yumm! Sangkaya with coconut ice is such a perfect combo.

author: Ziee Chiam
review_text: Love this place, just look at the picture. No queue as we were the first to arrived. If you come late, then yes long queue. Staffs were friendly. Desserts were awesome. So so so good. Love it!!! Will definitely revisit when I go Hat Yai again.

author: FARAH LIYANA
review_text:
We had much fun having a good ice-shaved (bingsu, garlic bread, caramel pudding, & drinks at here! 100% satisfied cuz all hot selling menu are so mouthwatering and delish! We will definitely come here again!

The ambience and deco are so cozy & warm. We were so lucky by the time we arrived, the cafe was not so crowded. We enjoyed the most!

author: Chian
review_text:
Still my favourite shaved ice spot in hatyai!!! Good food, good environment and great service. In love with their salted eye shaved ice!!

Tried their croffle for the first time and turned out a BOOMMM!!!! regret to try it too late!!! We ordered the kaya croffle , it’s so nicee mannnn!! Buttery and crunchy yummy! End ii we ordered the second one : salted egg croffle, it’s still good but i would recommend the kaya one more ❤️

author: Yaw Cheng Chong
review_text: Great place to chill and take pretty ins photo, salted egg bingsu and caramel bingsu are nice. Definitely would come back to try other flavour

author: Bobby Lornimitdee
review_text: It's comfortable for families, with average prices and great flavors. I especially love their Dirty Coffee.

author: Liaw Ben Hsia
review_text: Second visit here, but sadly the desserts were below expectations. The Thai milk tea especially was a big disappointment – definitely not worth the price. Overall, not a satisfying experience.

author: Anasuya Roshan
review_text:
This is a fantastic spot for satisfying your sweet cravings.

The bingsu servings are impressively large – easily shared among three adults, making it perfect for a group dessert outing. The finely shaved ice, paired with a variety of toppings, ensures a refreshing and delicious treat.

However, the highlight for me was the waffles. They were perfectly crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, with just the right amount of sweetness. Paired with their selection of toppings and syrups, the waffles were absolutely delightful.

The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it a great place to hang out with friends or enjoy some quiet time with a good dessert. The staff are friendly and attentive, ensuring a pleasant experience.

author: Nurkhalida Rahman
review_text: Very beautiful place. Went there in the evening Saturday, less people. Washroom complete with bidet. The wild berry ice shave so good, not too sweet. Clear matcha drink also nice tops with caramel. Will repeat again.

author: Alvin Toh
review_text: My first visit here. Place was nicely done up, air conditioned, clean and comfortable. Do prepare for the long wait for seats during weekends and peak hours. They have a small open field right beside the cafe with some chairs provided, so maybe you can consider takeaway or relax there while waiting for your table. Deserts here were pretty decent and nicely done. Drinks were normal.

author: LimKoppi
review_text: Our driver suggest this place to us. Need to take number and queue ya. Need to queue at least half an hour to one hour but it is worth to queue 😆😁 we all loves this cafe very much. All food and dessert is nice! And wish to go again.

author: Sharon Chen
review_text: Love the desserts here! Everything is fresh and beautifully presented. The bingsu is super soft and melts in your mouth. Cozy environment and friendly staff!

author: Wong Kok Ming
review_text:
The place is pack with tourists from all over the world to try their food and bingsu.

The environment of the place is very comfy and comfortable to enjoy food and drinks with friend and family.

The staff here is very friendly and helpful.  Number is given for the customer to wait for their turn and there is a bar code where you can scan and see their menus before getting your table.

The food here is delicious and got variety of selection to choose from.

author: Zen Yong
review_text:
If you’re visiting Hatyai, Chokdee Dim Sum is definitely one of those breakfast spots that locals and tourists alike recommend, so I decided to give it a try. It was a good experience overall, and I can see why it’s so popular.

The staff here are friendly and attentive, even though the place was quite busy during breakfast hours. Service was quick, and they patiently guided me through the dim sum selection process, which is a nice touch if it’s your first time there.

There are two dining areas – the main store and a newer, more spacious dining area just opposite. I chose to sit in the main store, as it is closer to the dim sum counter and has a more authentic, bustling atmosphere. The main store feels a bit more “classic,” while the newer section seems to cater to larger groups and tourists.

The price is reasonable and in line with what you would expect for a well-known dim sum place. The portions are small, but they match the price, which makes it easy to order and try a variety of dishes without wasting food.

Taste-wise, the dim sum itself was decent – I would say it was just ordinary compared to other places I have tried, but still enjoyable. I also ordered their Bah Kut Teh, which was slightly salty for my liking, though taste can be very subjective and others might find it just right.

Overall, Chokdee Dim Sum is a nice breakfast experience if you are in Hatyai. The variety of dishes, reasonable pricing, and lively atmosphere make it worth a visit. Just be sure to go early, as the place can get really crowded during peak hours.

author: Alphonse Eelric
review_text:
This place offers variety of Chinese style dim sum & Bak Kut Teh (Chinese clay pot sup with pork). Pricing wise is reasonable, but some time it might crowded with tourists from other province & Malaysia. Parking are plenty, park free at roadside, but beware! do not park at red white line or against the traffic as your car will be locked by traffic police & unlocking fee is whooping 1000baht!!
They have another hall opposite their outlet, customer can take seat at either side & order food they want.

author: Jony
review_text:
Since 1996, this beloved spot has been serving up mountains of delicious, affordable dim sum. The experience is part of the fun: just pick your favourites from the counter, and the staff steams them on the spot, delivering each one piping hot to your table.
Don't let the crowds scare you away! Their efficient system means you'll be seated in no time, ready to dig into classic dim sum or their famous Bak Kut Teh. With three locations, it’s easier than ever to get a taste of this local legend.

author: K M
review_text:
What's great?
Loved the you tiao with Kaya dip the most. Got 2 sets of it. Yam bun is so nicely oozing out! Amazing place with nice decorations. Get a seat number slip from the main shop, then cross the road to choose your steam dim sum from another shop, then cross back. No need to go over, if you do not want steamed stuff. Very crowded, but moves very fast.

Visit again?
Yes!

What's to improve?
Bak kut teh and steam pork ribs are ok. Not fantastic.

author: Henry Tan
review_text: Very reasonably priced and delicious dim sum in Hat Yai, definitely a must-go location 🫖🥢

author: Winther Tan
review_text: Very nice dim sum in hatyai. Always full, so need to go early. They r famous for their bak gut teh, but to me it seems too salty. But the dimsum is nice compare to many other places in Thailand n price is very affordable.

author: Yuhng Yeap
review_text:
Amazing dimsum place, definitely not overhyped. There's still quite a queue even at 10am. You order by taking a table number and a tray from the stuff, and pick any dimsum you want from their wide range of selection. They will steam it and sent it to your table. They have multiple stores with seating area around the block, some seatings stores are opposite the road.

They also have a bakkutteh store which I highly recommend to give it a try. The soup is a bit different from what we usually have in Malaysia, but still very delicious. Best part is definitely their pork cuts inside, super tender and soft, literally melts in your mouth.

Highly recommend getting more of their Thai specialty dimsum instead of classic ones you usually see in Malaysia for a more unique experience. Some highlights includes the steam cob and meat dimsum, various types of siewmai, and glutinous rice chicken. Their har gao is a flop tho, dry and tasteless, can skip it.

Recommended.

author: Min Khant Zaw
review_text:
Bustling old school dimsum place right in the middle of the city. A must have for breakfast! Also, their thai tea is one of the best in the city. Who knew pairing thai tea with dimsum will be such a great combo!

Friendly staff. Room with aircon available across the road. Plenty parking spaces available on the side of the road.

Very affordable price.

author: Gina K
review_text:
I understand that everyone has their own taste when it comes to dim sum. I’ve tried dim sum in many places—both in Thailand and abroad—but honestly, this is the one place I just don’t understand the hype.

Most of the customers here were foreigners, with only a few Thai diners. As for the taste, I personally found the dim sum quite disappointing. It was edible, but definitely not something I’d come back for.

That said, I really appreciated the staff here. They were friendly and attentive, and the service was excellent. While the food wasn’t for me, the warm hospitality made the experience more pleasant, but overall, this place still didn’t meet my expectations.

author: Ju Nguyen
review_text: From the food quality, service to atmotspher, personally I would like to give 5 star.

author: Stephie C
review_text: They got 3 shops here, waiting time around 10 mins only. Bak kut teh tastes quite good. Overall dim sum not bad. Worth for a try.

author: I'm Done
review_text:
A wide variety of dim sum options at very affordable prices, a table full of food for four cost us only 700 THB. Service was great and the space itself was roomy and comfortable.

However, one downside I would say was the staff's overwhelming presence. We were the only customers at the time, and over 10 staff members gathered closely around our table, watching us intently. I understand they wanted to provide prompt service, but it felt a bit excessive, a little more personal space for us would be so much better 😂

author: Raymond Beh
review_text: The dim sum is very fresh, the taste is good as well, hence the high review online. Strongly recommand to try their bak kut teh, way above my expectation, as the dish is not a star within thailand. I would say that this is as good as some of the best bak kut teh in Malaysia. Must try dish here in Hatyai

author: VC Loh
review_text: Love the dim sum and bakuteh, very fresh ingredients and nice.

author: Songren Lim
review_text: Decided to check this place out due to the close proximity to my accommodation. It was a delightful experience. The Ladyboss was friendly and ushered me to the air conditioned dining area which was a nice surprise. Felt their Bak Kut teh was decent but would definitely return for their unique dim sum dishes and variety.

author: Simon C
review_text: Great restaurant. You go to the main places on one side and then get a number and seat. With this number you cross the street and choose the food you want to eat. Mainly you find a variety of great tasting dim sum. The prices are super fair. With about 12-14 plates, beer and water we ended up with about 550 BHT. Would definitely come again!

author: Rohee Lee
review_text: The dim sum are really tasty! Their portion is small and you can try variety of choices. Ordered Bak kut Teh and the meat is tender, soup is really good. Very satisfying with their food, will go and eat again for next trip

author: Jaime See
review_text:
a different style of dim sum - miniature size.  not of d same variety 1 wld find in a typical dim sum restaurant.  taste has more of a fish sauce base, but subtle enough to taste d meat.

tried d bak kut teh which was a bit flat, not of d herbal flavor of klang, malaysia.  haadyai's bkt more on d salty side, more like a meat soup.

however, d char kuew teow was not bad at all.  has 'wok hei' n tastes good.

the milk tea n coffee were not up to par at all, but they use a squarish cup for their chinese tea.  a pleasing visual indeed...

author: Dr. WH Tan
review_text: The food here was undeniably delicious, but if you want to try their signature dim sum, you will need to place your order from across the street. This unique setup might require a bit of extra effort, but it is well worth it for the opportunity to savor their specialty dumplings, buns, and other delicacies.

author: Nivic Aun
review_text:
Stepping into Dim Sum Delight is like entering a culinary paradise for dim sum lovers. This cozy eatery offers an authentic and unforgettable dining experience, perfect for both seasoned dim sum enthusiasts and newcomers alike.

The ambiance is warm and inviting, with traditional decor that exudes charm and a hint of nostalgia. The layout is designed to encourage a communal dining experience, making it a great place for gatherings with family and friends.

The service at Dim Sum Delight is top-notch. The staff are friendly, attentive, and efficient, ensuring that your dining experience is smooth and enjoyable. They are knowledgeable about the menu and happy to make recommendations, which is especially helpful given the wide variety of dishes available.

The star of the show, of course, is the dim sum. Each dish is a testament to culinary excellence, crafted with fresh ingredients and cooked to perfection. The menu offers a great balance of classic favorites and unique creations, ensuring there’s something to please every palate.

Overall, Chokdee Dim Sum is a must-visit for anyone looking to savor the best of dim sum. With its welcoming atmosphere, excellent service, and mouthwatering dishes, it promises a dining experience that you’ll want to repeat time and again.

author: Under Cover
review_text:
We came here for lunch and were really happy with our overall experience. The restaurant is located just a couple of streets away from the main beach road, making it easy to find but still quiet enough to relax. The atmosphere is casual, clean, and comfortable, and the staff was very friendly and attentive. All dishes were freshly prepared and arrived quite fast.

I started with a Caesar salad, which looked nice and fresh, although there was a bit too much dressing for my taste. I would have preferred it lighter, but overall it was still enjoyable. We also ordered chicken wings on skewers, which looked amazing and came with a delicious sauce — perfectly grilled and full of flavor.

Another highlight was the Laab, a Thai-style minced meat salad with mint, onion, and herbs. It was served cold and packed with flavor — perfectly seasoned and very authentic. We also had squid with sauce, which looked great and tasted just as good. Another dish we tried was chicken in coconut sauce, which was absolutely delicious — creamy, flavorful, and perfectly balanced.

For drinks, we had water and pink milk, which was very sweet but refreshing. The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes — both Thai and Western options like pizza and sandwiches — plus a great selection of beers.

In total, we paid only 530 Baht for everything, which is incredibly affordable for such a touristy area. At the end, they even gave us a small mint candy with the bill — a nice touch. Overall, a great experience and definitely a place we’d recommend to anyone visiting the area.

author: Singh G
review_text: Overall it’s good expressive, i have been to oasis, coffee club and here and it tastes near to same. Good place. Got to visit this place after watching one of YouTube video to taste authentic Thai food and I’m not disappointed . Just a reminder, Pad Thai is noodles and not rice. Shrimp pineapple rice were best of all the menu. They also have bottle beers costing around 100 bhatt. Also the washrooms were super clean.

author: Neil Fairley
review_text: We have eaten here many times. The food, atmosphere and service are all tremendous it I superb value for money too. The satay sauce is to die for. Please if you read this get me email and send me the recipe so I can make it at home. 🙏photo says it all.

author: Raj G
review_text: Everything on the menu was served properly. Food is delicious. The pad Thai is on top of the world. Great drinks to complement Coconut water is definitely not something you should miss and stay away from the hot sauce obviously dip it in, add photos and videos but take too much of it and you get the heat

author: Ashley T (Shark and Eagle)
review_text: We are from Melbourne and solid fan of Doo Dee Melbourne, I was surprised Doo Dee was originally from Thailand I thought it was just some random name. The food is good and price is fair, I had curry crab for 350b, which would be cost 5 or more times for in Melbourne. Very happy and would def come back again.

author: Chong Wee
review_text: Very authentic Thai foods... Somtum is tasty,for the baked fish was awesome,the Thai curry fried crab really good

author: Dee D'Cruz
review_text:
Great little restaurant with very reasonable prices and huge variety of food, fresh seafood and even specialties like frogs legs which we tried!

We sat in the air conditioned restaurant and had probably the best Pad Thai of our trip! The fried rice and pork omelette were also delicious and we loved the Morning Glory (love adding some greens)!

Bonus points for the Iced Thai Tea being served ice cold and delicious!

author: Prianca bakshi
review_text:
Absolutely love the food here!!! I used to eat almost every day. So so reasonable too!
But, the staff, oooff. Most of them are rude and full of themselves. The one star goes because of those couple of waitstaff who were barely doing their job well!

Do try their red curry, cashew chicken, tom yum with fish, pad kra pao -some of my favourites.. but almost everything here was decent! Oh and also ask them to give you their seafood sauce. Yum yum!

author: Jakub Chrzanowski
review_text: Portions are a little small, also the taste was just so so. I had much better experience in Patong.

author: Darren Cantwell
review_text: The food is quite nice and it’s affordable. I did find a small hair amongst the chicken which is why I took off one star. The flavor was good.

author: Mika Salmela
review_text:
Very good quality food for a cheap price. Ice coffee was great (sweet) and the breakfast set tasted better than many hotels that have over twice the price. Kind service.

Pad thai was good.

I asked for Thai spicy tom yum soup and it truly was Thai spicy, be careful what you ask for. Must have been one of the spiciest so far. Still, the taste was amazing.

The neighboring table was praising even the chicken wings. I don't think I will go to any other restaurant for thai food this whole vacation.

author: Mia mia
review_text: the fried chicken wings and tom yum with fish are must order! Really enjoy the dinner with Thai foods here.

author: shin ri
review_text:
Food is great, price is cheap as well. Love their Tom yum soup with fish, it's exactly what I wanted.
They open from 9am onwards, so we had breakfast here everyday.

author: celinda.h
review_text: We found the portion size of the chicken basil to be quite small but the thai green curry (not pictured) was quite decent and delicious. Thai milk tea was not great and tasted a bit watered down. Great prices though! So cheap and would go back. Lots of staff who were very attentive.

author: Ruslan Panahov
review_text: Real authentic local food at crazy very good prices!!! Try not to fall for fake tourist traps guys compare any restaurant prices with this place and you can understand what must be near real price!

author: Seemantini Bose
review_text:
My go-to place in Phuket. Excellent food, absolutely reasonable. Heaven for seafood lovers like me. Their grills are to die for! Try out the grilled prawns, green pepper crabs, grilled white snapper.

Strategically located in Patong, you can either choose to walk from patong beach/ bangla road or take a tuktuk that will charge you 200 TBH. It’s adjacent to the hotel ‘Natural Resort’.

They have two seating areas, one open and the other one AC. Service is great and the waiting time for food is quite fast.

Don’t miss it if you enjoy seafood!

author: Natalia Reliszko
review_text: We visited this restaurant on our first day in Thailand, and it was outstanding. We traveled all over Thailand from Chiang Rai to Phi Phi and returned on our last day, curious if our impressions were a result of our first day of Thai cuisine, but no... the food was delicious, not overly contrived, not too sweet, not too heavy. Everything is fresh and served very quickly. AUTHENTIC UMAMI <3

author: Dru Lu
review_text: Ordered the grilled giant prawn and crabs which are the most expensive items here. But they grilled the crap out of it, till the point there’s no moisture left in the meat and it’s like tasting prawn jerky. The crab meat was so dry you can hardly get any meat from the claw. Do not order!

author: Weng Hau Hoon
review_text:
This is one of the restaurant with good food that the locals and tourist eat in Patong.
The BBQ Chicken Wing is delicious but the stir fry pork with mint can be skipped if you can't eat spicy food as it's actually quite spicy.
The Thai Iced tea and Rose Syrup with milk is tasty and cooling especially during hot weather.
Overall damage is about 500 baht and would definitely revisit again to try their Grilled fish and seafood.

author: Fan
review_text:
We came here because this place had such good reviews, but many other people thought that too. In the evening the queue is big and expect to wait a few minutes before you can enter.

The food is good, but not really great in my opinion.

What I loved was the original Thai bowl that they served the drinks in!

author: Tlangelani Mkhombo
review_text:
I went last week saturday around 20h00. It was quite busy but you could move around. It has a lot of markets selling Thai food from proper meals like pad thai and stir fried rice, to finger food like spring rolls and pork on a stick. They also sell fruits, some prepared and ready to eat (no fruit salads though). They also had some clothes and bags. The interesting ones were the guys with scorpions where you could take a picture for 10 baht if not buying. Vendors keep stopping you to buy from them, which is to be expected but can get annoying, but just refuse politely.
Prices for food was reasonable and written, so no negotiations needed. They were playing some music but you could talk. There was a bar for drinks where you could sit down and rest and eat your food from other stalls as long as you buy something from them, too. I went for food stalls and the vibe.

author: Frank P
review_text: 20251205 - night market near patong beach that is opened till late night. Sells variety of seafood, thai food, drinks and desserts. It is considered quite pricey compared to bangkok. Ordered iced thai tea, iced thai coffee and mango sticky rice. The drinks are ok but the mango sticky rice is disappointing, with dry rice that sticks together and mango that is not so sweet. I would consider going to nearby mall food court to eat instead. The roti banana nutella outside the market along the main road is nice though, with ripe and sweet banana.

author: Mauricio
review_text:
Love this night food market located right in the middle of Bangla Rd
Awesome local street food including a huge variety of seafood amongst other great dishes
It gets pretty busy which adds to the atmosphere and is a great place to eat before a night out on the town

author: Rajeev Rajan
review_text:
Great place to have some nice seafood & other non-vegetarian delicacies - like chicken & other meat! Be ready to bargain to get the best deal.

Too crowded on weekends & rightly so with all the party options around.

author: Krasimira Valkanova
review_text: Pretty good fresh sea food one can get in here but be careful because they're cheating with the scales and charge more than they should. We checked a few places before we decided where to eat. For example we told one guy to measure two of the big tiger prawns and they we half a kg on his scale. Went to another picked two smaller tiger prawns and it showed 600kg on his scale.... so yeah watch out. We've chosen yummy yummy and it was very yummy :)) fried rice with vegetables, one octopus skewer and two huge tiger prawns with garlic butter sauce, it was cooked to perfection and just enough for two people. And all together our dinner was half as cheap if went to a restaurant so didn't regret it and will go back again. 4 stars only because some of them are cheating. 5 stars for food

author: Glynis Brown
review_text:
Love the excitement of Bangla specially the street food.
Many thanks to Ceylon and staff. Done a wonderful job cooking our food

author: Toon Tran
review_text:
Bangla Night Market: Hits, Misses, and the Famous Roti!
The Bangla Night Market (บางลา ไนท์ มาร์เก็ต) offers a buzzing late-night culinary hub near Patong Beach, selling a variety of seafood, Thai food, drinks, and desserts until the early hours.
What to Expect:
* Offerings & Price: You can find almost any kind of street food, though it is considered quite pricey compared to Bangkok's markets.
* The Drinks: Your order of iced Thai tea and iced Thai coffee were noted as "OK," serving as standard refreshments.
The Disappointments:
* The market's famous Thai dessert, mango sticky rice, was unfortunately disappointing, described as having dry rice that sticks together and mango that is not so sweet.
The Recommended Alternative:
Based on this experience, a better dining alternative for overall quality is suggested: "I would consider going to nearby mall food court to eat instead."
The Must-Try Street Food:
Despite the disappointing mango sticky rice, don't miss the street vendors just outside the market: the roti banana nutella along the main road is nice, made with ripe and sweet banana—a perfect, sweet ending to your evening!
Bangla Night Market
(Near Patong Beach)

author: Aman Chawla
review_text:
Bangla Night Market, Phuket 🌃🍢🔥
A vibrant spot for Thai street food, fruit shakes, and quick shopping, located just off Bangla Road. After exploring the market, you’re steps away from top pubs and dance clubs like Illuzion, Tiger Nightclub, Sugar Club, and Barfunk — perfect for partying, live DJs, and late-night vibes. Busy, colourful, and great for food + nightlife in one place!

author: mohd idham
review_text: Fresh Seafood , choose and they will cook .Come here only for eating. Its cheap compare to other place . Portion and drink also big.. 😁

author: Nabeal Nasser
review_text: To find the truly good luxury spots, you have to gatekeep a little. They’re not obvious—you need to earn them by looking hard. Be patient, explore, and eventually you’ll discover those hidden gems worth everything.

author: Rinku
review_text: Best place for enjoyment. Its open in evening 6pm to 2am. Available dance club bar food restaurant. Also Available shopping market where you can get clothes or other things. Its street market and one of best place for enjoyment in phuket for those who liking drinking etc.

author: Danika Rose
review_text: From a cultural standpoint, great - the locals definitely thrive off the tourism however they must know the word “no” as the pushing gets old, they pester & follow you making you feel obligated to say yes, they also charge Australian prices, if you’re not bartering you’re definitely getting ripped off. The locals less polite here, making you feel very rude for saying no. The toilets are 10baht & you’re rushed, cultural shock for us aussies. They physically drag you away/grab your arm/ follow you for the adult shows, we felt especially bad for the men as the women just wouldn’t stop no matter how many times they said no or try to walk away.. it’s a whole new level of persistent, we saw men physically have to pull the ladies hands off them even if they had girlfriends. Thai ladies would guilt men saying “you no think I’m beautiful” and act sad guilting men. There are also male adult shows however the men aren’t nearly as persistent as the women. We did it once because we’re in Thailand but we will probably never come back to this market

author: Dharmendra Bhudia
review_text: Really tasty food and lots to choose from. Price are good also. A must id your in the area

author: Sandeep Anand
review_text:
This ain't for the the sensitive stomach kind.
You can have the normal seafood here of course.
What I tried are experiences ☺️

Grilled frog and a sea conch.. near the end almost of the market.

It really is true, they taste like chicken.
Disclaimer I don't have a well developed pallet 😂

author: abdul AM
review_text: One of the most important and beautiful activities in Thailand is visiting the night markets and experiencing the food and the wonderful atmosphere.

author: Willie B
review_text:
The night market is pretty awesome! It is a massive maze of food and shops. Pricing is great and its covered as well as can be. Consider it a large flea market if you're from the states.

It is hot so bring your fan and a towel if you're a sweater like me. If you're a germaphobe bring hand sanitizer.

You can haggle on prices here so give them your best offer before you settle on souvenir prices but don't cheat them. They are trying to make some money after all.

author: Morit Lahlali
review_text: The food was meh. Pretty sure we got scammed with a lobster. The one we got was way smaller than the one we bought and weighed. Oh well

author: Wayne Tota
review_text: Im not a nightout person but was buffled at what i saw😂.. noisy stuff, free adverts of everything ..they sell anything..check out all videos on my youtube @drwaynetota. I uploaded them all will upload some here. I only managed to eat Mcdonalds, afraid to be pulled into some bar😂

author: Aditya Raj
review_text: Crowded places, delicious and local dish, must try lobster here and fish here.

author: Ritika
review_text: Loud music and brings lights all over, good to visit when in Phuket. V similar to Pattaya walking street. Thai street food is good, coconut icecream is a must try.

author: Astrid Chavez
review_text: Why did I pay 400$ when I went? I got the fried fish and it was so deep fried you couldn’t even taste the fish. Also left the skin on which was definitely a weird choice. Got the “special drink” and it was straight up vintage dressing for a salad. but waitress was really sweet! Wouldn’t really recommend unless you wanna spend a lot of money for fast food quality food fr.

author: A S
review_text: worth trying. Price are reasonable. taste of the food is good but only spicy sauce so be aware of that.

author: Arika Mikirin
review_text:
Good foods and enthusiated employees.
Also have music. Feel really good.

author: Nhi Huynh
review_text: Nong - Farm to Grill is a hidden gem in Ho Chi Minh City, offering a unique farm-to-table dining experience. The menu highlights fresh, high-quality ingredients, expertly grilled to perfection. The meats are tender and flavorful, while the vegetable sides are vibrant and well-seasoned. The cozy, rustic ambiance adds to the charm, making it a perfect spot for a casual dinner or a special occasion. The staff is attentive and knowledgeable about the menu, enhancing the overall experience. If you’re a fan of wholesome, thoughtfully prepared meals, Nong is a must-try.

author: Mr. Toilet
review_text:
Food was fine, you have to grill the meat yourself. But food preparation was very slow, we waited for a very long time even when it was just plates of raw meat.
Great atmosphere for hanging out, a bit loud because there was a birthday party. Clean restaurant.

author: Dang Loi
review_text: Not good not bad, the price is higher than other restaurants in the neighborhood, the roof is useless when raining, and it quite hot even after raining

author: AL S.
review_text: The food is good with nice atmosphere. It’s such a chill place

author: Đức Trần
review_text: Nice spot to hang out with friends. Will visit again next time!

author: Vân Anh Phạm Quỳnh
review_text: Good service, really nice staff and the food absolutely delicious!!

author: Linda
review_text: Fresh and delicious and great customer service and food is delicious! Hoang Vu is great, atmosphere is great and very good. Highly recommend!

author: Johnny
review_text: Omg ! So delicious ! Everyone must come ! I am from Taiwan ! I love Vietnam food here !

author: katiie nguyen
review_text: Gia A was really patient and friendly. Her personality was top notch. A must try place.

author: 68_10_Lê Hồng Hảo
review_text: Tasty food, kinda hot but it doesn't matter since the service overall wasn't bad

author: Nguyen Tuyet Trinh
review_text: Excelent services, delicous foods and spacious room. I will comeback more often. 💕

author: Kien Nguyen
review_text: The apmostphere is very good, the food is excellent and the service is great.

author: Hang Le
review_text: First of all, Nong would like to sincerely thank you for taking the time to evaluate and share your opinions about the quality of service and food at Nong. Your feedback is a source of motivation for Nong to constantly improve and enhance … More

author: Ngoc Minh
review_text:
The restaurant near my house is always crowded with customers. I went to the restaurant on a weekday and booked a table in advance, so I didn't have to wait, I got a table right away. Because it was a weekday, it wasn't crowded, although I saw customers coming and going constantly, there were still many empty tables in the back. 
The staff were friendly and enthusiastic, and the order was taken very quickly. 
The food we ordered was quite a lot. 
The grilled pork belly and sturgeon with green mustard were delicious, the meat was soft and moist, the restaurant used medium charcoal, the fire wasn't too big and smoky like other restaurants, it took a bit longer to grill but it was worth the wait. The jellyfish salad was okay, with a little jellyfish it was a bit boring to eat. The chicken cartilage was normal. Everyone praised the crab and sweet potato vermicelli, so I ordered a portion. The vermicelli made the sauce richer, there was real crab meat but it was dry, I didn't like this dish. The avocado salad and fried taro were delicious, very attractive. The fried sturgeon cartilage was firm, the grilled fish was soft and delicious, there was a lot of garlic. The vegetable tray was big like its name. As for the drinks, they were all similar, the lemon tea was strange and strange, I couldn't get used to it. Overall, the food was okay. 300 fish per person was enough to fill us up.

author: Uyên Nguyễn Ngọc Phương
review_text: The meat is fresh and tender, but the ribs should be scored or divided into long strips to make it easier to grill. The jellyfish salad is not very harmonious in taste, the spicy taste is overwhelming the other ingredients. The restaurant has a dish of salted leaves with fragrant flavor, which goes well with the meat. In addition, the vegetable tray is fresh and the portion is just right.

author: Nguyen Van
review_text: The ambiance is beautiful, the food is delicious, and the prices are reasonable. The staff are enthusiastic and take good care of the customers.

author: Thanh NGO
review_text:
The food was delicious, seasoned perfectly to our group's taste. The fried rice was amazing.
The staff were all enthusiastic and quick. We will definitely come back!
It's recommended to make a reservation in advance as the restaurant gets quite crowded.

author: Andrew Truong
review_text: This place is huge with private rooms but you’ll have to book early because it is very busy! They do several course meals depending on what you choose. Usually hosts parties and events so not the place you go to if you want a quiet evening. Service was great

author: Czar Esterak
review_text: We had a truly great evening at this restaurant. The food was delicious, fresh, and perfectly prepared. The service was friendly, efficient, and professional, which made us feel well taken care of. The atmosphere was welcoming and pleasant, creating a comfortable place to relax and enjoy our meal. It was a wonderful overall experience.

author: Sang Chau
review_text: Nice place with local food for a gathering or birthday party. The food is fresh and the taste is really good and really Vietnamese. It is really crowded during weekends, the staff in the parking lot is really supportive to help guests to park their car/bike but since in weekend, it's really crowded so take time to park so prepare extra time for this.

author: Khanh Khanh
review_text: We ordered a variety of grilled fish, pork, and vegetables, all cooked to perfection. Excellent service, and an authentic cultural dining experience. Whether you're looking for a casual meal or a special dinner with friends and family, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit. I’ll be coming back for sure!

author: hung nguyen
review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Làng Nướng Nam Bộ and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. From the moment I stepped foot into the restaurant, I was greeted with warm hospitality and a cozy ambiance that set the stage for a memorable evening.

The highlight of my visit was undoubtedly the delectable array of grilled dishes. Làng Nướng Nam Bộ truly knows how to bring out the flavors in their dishes, as each bite was bursting with succulent and perfectly cooked meats. Whether it was the tender grilled beef, the flavorful marinated chicken, or the fresh seafood, every dish was a delightful combination of textures and tastes.

What impressed me even more was the attention to detail in their presentation. Each dish was beautifully arranged, showcasing the culinary artistry that goes into their creations. The vibrant colors and enticing aromas added to the overall sensory experience, making the meal even more enjoyable.

Not only was the food exceptional, but the service was top-notch as well. The staff at Làng Nướng Nam Bộ were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. They took the time to explain the menu options and offer recommendations, ensuring that every guest had a personalized dining experience.

The restaurant itself boasts a charming and cozy atmosphere, making it the perfect place to enjoy a meal with friends, family, or that special someone. The spacious seating arrangements and tasteful decor create a welcoming ambiance that enhances the dining experience.

author: Thu Hương Phạm
review_text:
Recently, my company held a party here. My first impression was that the VIP room was quite airy and had good lighting. However, I found the air conditioning position to be not very suitable. If the temperature was set low for people on the edge to be cool, people in the middle right under the air conditioner would be very cold.

Regarding the food, there was a wide variety of dishes, the prices were a bit high.

Regarding the taste of the food, I generally found it a bit salty. Almost all the dishes were like that. There was a cheese beef dish with a delicious sauce, but when I ate the beef, it was salty, so I felt a bit regretful.

The restroom was clean and had air conditioning.

author: Nhut Le Quang
review_text:
Ideal place to organize meetings, including wedding parties because there are many halls with 5-10 tables. There are open spaces and private rooms, serving a variety of guests.

The front gate of the restaurant is easy to recognize because it is the busiest on the street. There are many staff guiding parking to avoid traffic jams, and staff guiding to the banquet hall.
There is an elevator but it is often overloaded if there are many parties on the weekend. I had to use the stairs because I didn't want to waste time waiting.
The toilet on the ground floor had air conditioning when I went, but the 3rd floor did not.

The food was also quite tasty. The party menu was quite diverse.
Opening hours are until 22:30 but there is support for extra guests if the fun is not over yet. I am weak so I didn't stay until that time to check :D

Come to have a party at the restaurant around the end of the year, there are Christmas decorations with many more virtual living corners

author: Duc Lq
review_text:
The road is easy to go, motorbikes are parked opposite, remember to cross the road, this part is a bit reckless.
The VIP room upstairs is spacious and okay, the hallway is too much smoking and there is no ventilation so the smoke fills the hallway.
The food is okay, the service is okay.
The investment in seasonal decoration.

author: Phuoc Long Nguyen
review_text:
Nam Bo Grilled Village is located on Duong Duc Hien Street, Tay Thanh Ward, Tan Phu District, an ideal culinary destination for those who love traditional grilled dishes with rich Southern flavors. The restaurant's location is quite easy to find, located right in a busy residential area and convenient for travel, with a spacious parking lot, so it is very convenient for both motorbikes and cars. 

The restaurant space is spacious and airy with a style close to nature, imbued with the Southern style. The restaurant has many areas, suitable for many different groups of guests such as families, friends, or company parties. The space is very sparkling when lit up in the evening, creating a cozy but equally comfortable feeling. 

Regarding food, the restaurant serves a variety of grilled dishes - from seafood, beef, chicken to rustic dishes such as hot pot with fish sauce, grilled snakehead fish, grilled chicken with salt and chili... The flavor of the dishes is rich, delicious, the ingredients are fresh and delicious, and the preparation is standard. In particular, the dipping sauce here is very unique, contributing to enhancing the flavor of the grilled dishes. 

The staff is friendly, quick and enthusiastic. Even though the restaurant is crowded, you still don't have to wait too long to order. The price is reasonable compared to the quality and space it provides. 

Overall, this is an ideal place to enjoy Southern cuisine in the heart of Saigon, from seafood, beef, chicken to rustic dishes such as fish sauce hotpot, grilled snakehead fish, grilled chicken with salt and chili... The flavor of the dishes is rich, delicious, the ingredients are fresh and well-prepared. In particular, the dipping sauce here is very unique, contributing to enhancing the flavor of the dish!

author: Lê Bảo Trân Trần
review_text: Yesterday was my first experience at The Chill's Tay Thanh branch, but it was really terrible! I won't comment on the food because everyone has different tastes, so I won't give a detailed review. But the important thing is, the staff seem to lack proper training. I arrived at 6 PM and stayed until 8 PM. From the moment I bought my ticket until I started eating, I had a very unpleasant experience with the staff. The service was incredibly poor. The staff were all standing around, in clumps, and when I needed a grill change, no one came to help. There was absolutely no quick response, even though my table was burning and smoke was billowing everywhere. They just crowded around chatting and were very impolite. I really disliked the staff's attitude. Many of them were even staring intently at our table. Overall, I was extremely disappointed.

author: Thuỷ Tiên Lê
review_text:
I visited this grilled meat buffet restaurant because the reviews were okay (maybe because the staff asked for reviews :)))), but the actual experience was quite disappointing. The meat was okay, not too special. The appetizer line was cold and not delicious. There were a few staff so sometimes I had to call once or twice to be served, but they were still very enthusiastic, especially the staff who changed the grill and helped with table reservations - I still appreciate this 👍

However, after finishing the meal, I had a stomachache and quite severe diarrhea. I don't know if it was because of the food or how it was preserved, especially the kimchi that showed signs of being expired (sour and very smelly) which really made me uncomfortable. Plus, when I changed the grill, there was a lot of detergent left on the grill.

Although it was only 139k, I can't ask for much. I hope the restaurant will review the hygiene and food quality, because this experience makes me not dare to come back.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Bảo Phạm
review_text: The grilled food was okay, marinated but still tasted bland when grilled! The fried food counter was bad and cold. When a staff member asked for help, they were confused (there were a few male staff members who were still enthusiastic). It was raining and the food leaked? When the staff asked to go upstairs to eat, the staff had already arranged all the seats for new customers, but there was no more room for the old customers who had just had a leak like me? When we took them upstairs above the kitchen, the food still leaked. The experience at this restaurant was really bad. This is the first time I have had to review a restaurant and give it 1* like this. The restaurant should retrain the staff and fix the roof!

author: Đại Dương Nguyễn
review_text:
Pinkpong Buffet is a dining destination well worth experiencing, especially for those who love a youthful atmosphere and diverse cuisine. From the moment I entered, I was impressed by the modern decor, the cute color scheme, the cleanliness, and the comfortable feeling it created for diners. The tables and chairs were neatly arranged, suitable for groups of friends, families, or celebratory meals.

The most outstanding feature of Pinkpong Buffet is the quality of the food. The dishes are attractively presented and diverse, ranging from grilled meats, seafood, fried dishes, side dishes, to desserts. The food is fresh, seasoned perfectly, and the grilled dishes are particularly flavorful, aromatic, and not greasy. The dessert counter is also very appealing with many types of cakes, fruits, and sweets – you can eat them endlessly without getting bored.

In addition, the staff at Pinkpong are very quick, friendly, and enthusiastic in assisting customers when needed. The buffet price is reasonable compared to the quality and quantity of food, making it well worth the experience. Overall, Pinkpong buffet is an ideal choice for gathering, enjoying a fun meal, and savoring delicious food with family and friends.

author: Hướng Dương Shop Hoa
review_text:
Basic prices range from 125,000 to ~155,000 VND/person, depending on the package (regular buffet or combo with hotpot).
Soft drink buffet package adds about 30,000 VND, and can include craft beer packages (~75K).
More than 40 diverse grilled dishes: American beef, pork belly, chicken wings, seafood such as shrimp, squid, octopus — marinated with special tamarind sauce, green chili salt, salted eggs, etc.
Dishes change seasonally to ensure fresh ingredients.
On-site processing line, fried food, desserts, fresh fruit, ice cream and detox water if you choose an additional package.
Youthful design, black-red color scheme combined with neon LED lights, vibrant party vibe, suitable for groups of friends or young families.
Spacious, airy space, neat tables and chairs, good distance between tables to avoid smoke and grease.
Friendly and enthusiastic staff.

author: Thu Hương Phạm
review_text:
The restaurant has a spacious, airy space, many seats, fully equipped with fans so it is quite cool.
The menu is diverse with many different dishes. There are grilled dishes, hot pot dishes and pre-cooked dishes. The price is reasonable, affordable. The taste is suitable for me and my group of friends.
The car will be parked right on the sidewalk in front of the restaurant, there is a parking attendant.
The downside of the restaurant is that we ordered fried squid eggs with fish sauce, our group mentioned it twice but still did not see this dish so in the end we paid. When asked, both times the staff responded that it was being prepared.
The bill was also a bit slow to pay.
The last point is that the restaurant gives away guava for dessert.

review_text: The restaurant has a spacious, airy, and cozy atmosphere, like having a drink on your own porch. The food is delicious and very reasonably priced. The bald-headed owner looks funny and cheerful; for some reason, he reminds me of Dien Ba Quang from The Smiling Proud Wanderer, haha.

author: Minh Hải Đoàn

When I entered the restaurant, it was crowded so there was no staff to guide me to find a table, I actively went to find it but the staff was too busy, so I stood there for about 10 minutes before getting to the table.
When the food arrived, there was no dipping sauce, I asked twice, waited 15 minutes for the dipping sauce.
I don't blame the staff, the restaurant was too crowded.
In short, I won't visit the restaurant again, it was a pretty bad experience, I went with my family, waited for almost an hour and waited another 15 minutes for the dipping sauce.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Quý Mai
review_text:
Kieu Bao's grilled pork vermicelli restaurant seems to be packed with customers all the time. I went there to eat and saw orders constantly coming and going on the app.

The full grilled pork vermicelli dish costs 33k VND as pictured, including grilled pork, grilled spring rolls, and fried spring rolls. The portion is decent for the price. A plus point is probably the fresh vegetables and pickles, which are refilled free once.

A downside is that the restaurant space is quite small, with tables and chairs placed close together, so it can feel a bit cramped and noisy when it's crowded. Parking is available in the alleyway with assistance.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: masaki k
review_text:
It seems to be a sister store in District 1, so I wanted to try it out, so I went! Parking is on the sidewalk in front of the store. No car parking is available. The store is on the first floor, so there's an ordering area in the middle. Everyone else was ordering on their smartphones, but I asked to see the menu, pointed at it, ordered, and paid on the spot. After that, you're given a receipt and a plate, which you hand to the staff inside the store and sit at the front and wait. What I ordered was different from last time, but the soup was in the same container with a plate on it, and you could pour it over the noodles to your liking. You can also add chili peppers to your liking. Then, add lots of vegetables and mix them together before eating.
The spring rolls were crispy and moist on the inside, the sautéed pork was tender, and the minced meat was very tasty. So, 34,000₫ (about 200 yen) is a bargain.
It's great that there are other stores in the same chain in the direction you're heading, so you can eat there no matter which way you go😃

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Tín Nguyễn Phúc
review_text:
The restaurant is a bit crowded so it feels a bit stuffy and not very comfortable.
The restaurant has a parking lot, so if you want to eat, go into the alley
The food here costs from 28k, I ordered a portion of meat and spring rolls for 32k.
I got an extra portion of vegetables and noodles for free.
Iced tea here is charged at 3k.
In general, the food is okay

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Phúc Nguyễn
review_text: Delicious grilled pork vermicelli with golden brown grilled pork, well marinated, served with soft rice noodles, fresh vegetables and sweet and sour fish sauce. The attractive blend of flavors, rich in Vietnamese, makes anyone who eats it fall in love.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Tâm Nguyễn Thị Thanh
review_text:
Today I visited Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Noodles restaurant, but the experience wasn't good. Parking was full, so I had to drive deep into the alley and park and move my motorbike myself; no one helped.

The staff were quite rude. When carrying food or clearing bowls, chopsticks, and spoons, they threw them into the trash can, creating a very unpleasant noise. The space was already noisy, and the service, which seemed to want to drive customers away, made the experience uncomfortable.
The grilled pork was also slightly burnt. I hope the restaurant reviews its service and food quality, because having such an experience while eating out is really unacceptable.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: N S
review_text: I'm a tourist, but after visiting AEON, I wanted to eat Bun Thit Nung, so I went there, knowing it wasn't a tourist spot. I ordered using the menu, got in line, and got my takeout right away. It's cheap, fast, delicious, and has a local food vibe, so I recommend it. It was a bit of a challenge walking from AEON, with some difficult crosswalks, but if you try, you can get there.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Mì Tôm Review dạo
review_text:
🥢 Review of Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Vermicelli

If you love grilled pork vermicelli, you should definitely try Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Vermicelli. I ate there recently and was very satisfied.

The first positive point is that the grilled pork is marinated very well, grilled evenly to a golden brown, and has a light layer of fat so it's not dry. The meat is tender, fragrant, and not overly burnt like at many other places.

The vermicelli portion is generous, the noodles are thin and soft, and it comes with clean and fresh vegetables. What I liked most was the pickled vegetables here; they're perfectly seasoned, not too sweet or too strong.

The dipping sauce is delicious and well-balanced, and it's incredibly addictive when poured over the vermicelli. Adding a bowl of spring rolls makes it even better.

A bowl of grilled pork vermicelli costs around 30k VND, and it's very filling.

Especially noteworthy is that the vermicelli and vegetables are FREE!

In short, if you like flavorful grilled pork vermicelli with delicious meat at an affordable price, Kieu Bao is a great choice!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Pu Lê
review_text: I ordered SPF but there was no fish sauce, so what am I supposed to eat? The restaurant intentionally provided the wrong phone number so I couldn't reach them; they're dishonest in their business practices!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Đi chơi
review_text:
If you want to wait, clean the table yourself, and go to the restaurant to order the food, I recommend it

but I sat and waited for 30 minutes without the food coming
the staff took the bill and lost it
when I went back to the cashier, they kept asking me to wait
?
experience 1/10

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: ngan vo
review_text: Buy fish sauce to take home and use it yourself? First time but the staff like qq didn't give any instructions, the food isn't special and it's expensive, first time is like last time

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Minh Anh Phạm
review_text: The food is incredibly delicious, and the prices are cheaper than many other places I've eaten at. Highly recommend! 👍👍👍

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: truong nguyen
review_text: The service is bad, the staff is understaffed, I keep ordering more noodles but they still don't come out.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Shen Leo
review_text: Delicious grilled meat, spring rolls, and rice noodles; reasonably priced and quite cheap. The initial portion size is just right, but if you want to be full, you can add extra vegetables and noodles for free, which is great!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Trần T Tuyết Nghi
review_text: We waited 20 minutes for our meal, people who arrived later got served first, and when we asked the staff, they were completely clueless and didn't know how to answer. I've been to many restaurants, but this one has the worst service.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: KASI PHƯƠNG
review_text: 📍 Space: Spacious, airy seating, but no air conditioning so it can be a bit hot at noon. 🧾 Service: There are many staff so the food comes out quickly, but you have to order at the counter first so it's a bit inconvenient if you go with a large group. When I went, the restaurant was quite empty, I saw the staff gathered together talking to each other, it didn't affect anything but it was a bit unprofessional. 🍜 Food: depends on your taste: flavorful grilled meat, well-mixed fish sauce, fresh vegetables. 🛵 Parking: There is parking in the alley, free for customers eating at the restaurant - a big plus!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Vy Thuý
review_text: The restaurant offers free extra noodles and vegetables, but for my appetite, one bowl like the one in the picture was enough to fill me up. The taste was pretty good.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Minh Vũ Quang
review_text: Delicious grilled spring rolls, free noodles and vegetables per person. Food comes out quickly.

author: Ida Jørgensen
review_text:
U ordered your food, get upstairs and give your ticket to the waitress, find an empty seat she will give u your food and drink in just a second. This restaurant only serve bun (cold dishes).
The food is really good at local price. The restaurant looks "ok", meaning u can see napkins on the floor here and there, but the tables were clean.
Question is,  would I be back to eat at this restaurant?  Definitely yes, the food is so good.

author: LexTeo8888
review_text:
Was trying to find the roast pork Banh mi and when I saw a long queue at this eatery, silly me thought this was it. Halfway through I realised they were selling grilled meats and vermicelli and decided why not.

Ordered a full set plus an additional plate of grilled meat and iced tea for VND76,000...which was very reasonable as there were proper seating and fans (no Aircon as per norm).

Was abit disgruntled when I was served the meats which were not even warm but all my disappointment disappeared when I tried my first taste. It was really not bad for a 4.1 Google rating. Not mind-blowing but I got my money's worth for sure!

What got me swooning was the chilli mixture that you put together with the fish sauce dipping. It was spicy 🔥 but in a good way! Really elevated the dining experience from not bad to good!

Gave only 4 stars though as this is Vietnam and I have higher expectations whereas if this was served to me in Singapore...maybe 4.5.

author: Stephen Romans
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Kieu Bao Barbecue Rice Noodles was one of the best meals I had on this trip—I loved it so much I went back twice. They have an easy-to-read English menu, which makes ordering simple, but it still feels like a very local spot. The prices are incredible for the quality. The rice noodles with pork and spring roll are absolutely amazing and ended up being my favorite meal of the entire trip. A must-try if you’re in the area!

author: Manuel Dresselmann
review_text:
We found this place on Google looking for foodplaces to be in the City. We almost passed the Shop since downstairs looks more like a garage for motorbikes than a Restaurant.

At a very small counter you order your mal which is either grillen pork, minced pork or springrolls in a combination with glass noodles and greens. You can also mix it for a combination of All 3 Extras. If you wish for more noodles additions are free.

After your order you can go upstairs, take a seat and wait for your order to arrive. The dining area is very minimalistic which gives the place a unique feel. The food is what it is all about. A whole 2 liter Bucket of "nuoc mam" the local fish sauce makes the dish. Its fresh, its well made and screams "umami".

We enjoyed it a lot.

author: Norbert
review_text:
AMAZING PLACE. The prices are totally local and the food is delicious. The staff is super nice, too.

Heads up for Europeans/Americans: I’d recommend ordering extra spring rolls or meat. The portions are 'Vietnamese style,' but honestly, even if you order 3 portions, the price is still low 😅. Highly recommend!! I came here 2 days in a row!

author: Fred Jaeger
review_text:
You have to order first and pay.
It was the best price value for you can get here.
I was a bit worried about the salad cleanliness tho. Let's see in a few days

Nuoc mam was good. Everything was good.
Sometimes you have bikes in here though because of delivery.

33k vnd for 1 bowl

author: Sarah C
review_text: Food was super affordable and delicious. Seating is upstairs and it can get quite hot in the Viet heat but that’s normal with no AC. The sauces were in a giant pail which was amazing, you could use as much as you wanted. The fresh leaves were amazing to eat with your main. 10/10 would come back. Cash only btw!

author: Angeline Ng
review_text:
Want a simple hearty meal with bbq pork and spring rolls. It’s certainly a local joint , for a moment u would think it’s a bike shop however the place has so many bike inside for Grab delivery collectors and Patrons to ride and dine. Seats are also available upstairs, so it's really nice and clean for just a quick Bún Thịt Nướng (Vietnamese Grilled Pork & Rice Noodles)
Cheap and good spot to come to for a quick meal. Will definitely come back

author: V. L. (VonMeetsWorld)
review_text:
I visited Kiều Bảo in October 2025.
The bowl of Bún Thịt Nướng from Kiều Bảo is a beautiful expression of Saigon’s everyday artistry — humble, balanced, and quietly confident.

The white rice noodles forming a soft cloud at the base; golden spring roll resting on one side; charred pork slices and grilled pork patties spread over the top; crushed peanuts scattered like tiny jewels; a small nest of pickled carrots and scallions providing color and bite.

The grilled pork — smoky, slightly caramelized, with visible grill marks — carries that unmistakable aroma of lemongrass and fish sauce that instantly awakens your appetite. Each bite has that sweet–savory contrast the Vietnamese have perfected: first the gentle crunch of the seared surface, then the tender, juicy meat that almost melts.

Then there’s the chả giò — the fried spring roll — crisp and golden on the outside, shattering audibly with the first bite.

The basket of lettuce and cucumber is crisp and cool, almost dewy, cutting through the richness of the meat. When you tear the greens with your fingers and fold them into the bowl, they bring everything to life — suddenly, the dish feels lighter, brighter, and more alive.

Finally, when you pour over the nước chấm (fish sauce dressing), the whole bowl transforms.

For my full review, do check out my video diary in my YouTube Channel!

author: Jesus Estrada
review_text: Tried a few days ago for a late lunch but they were out of spring rolls so I left and came back. The first time, the register lady was dismissive. This time, the register lady was kind. The staff are helpful. There is a menu with pictures and English descriptions. The price is really affordable. The meal was really good. The minced pork was ok, and the grilled pork was great, if not a little dry. The spring rolls are on the small side but crispy and tasted pretty good. One bite had an off flavor, but the rest of everything was very tasty. Paid in cash. Will return.

author: Hà Minh Dũng
review_text: super affordable and good value for money. staff super nice n cute. thats why they full all the time. taste is good compare to price. order a full bowl will cost roughly 1.5 usd. with first free refill of veggie and rice noodle. this restaurant is super cool in this area

author: Julie Xiao
review_text: I came after being recommended by a local.   You order at the cashier downstairs and they deliver your order to your table upstairs. This place specializes in bún thịt nướng which is grilled pork served over vermicelli noodles with fresh herbs, vegetables, and fish sauce. I like that they give you a bucket (yes, a literal bucket) of nước chấm (fish sauce). It's super affordable ($1) and it's very filling especially if you get two spring rolls. I would definitely recommend!

author: Chi Pham
review_text: This place was introduced to me as a popular tourist spot, so it was understandably quite busy. The ordering process was a bit confusing ay first - you have to order and pay at the counter, then choose a seat and wait for someone to collect your receipt and prepare your food. The process could definitely be streamlined. Service and hygiene weren’t the best, but I’d still recommend it as a fairly healthy, reasonably priced and light meal option.

author: Wasurat Niyomrat
review_text: This restaurant doesn’t have a huge menu, but it serves simple Vietnamese dishes that are incredibly delicious no matter how they’re prepared. The fresh vegetables are refillable for free, which I really appreciated. I wish they had a branch in Thailand! In conclusion, I highly recommend this place. 🧡🧡🧡

author: Nicholas Lim
review_text:
This place deserves more than Michelin Guide. Superb food at unbelievable prices. Spring rolls are insanely good (spring rolls > grilled pork). You must try this place if you are in Saigon. The locals absolutely love this place and the prices are just too cheap for such a heavenly bowl of perfection. Each bowl comes with a hearty amount of greens and the big bucket of fish sauce is at your disposal. Add however much to your liking.

1) Order your meal at the counter
2) Pay with cash only and receive a receipt for your order
3) Pass the receipt to the kitchen for your meal
4) Sit back at your table and wait to be served

author: Deon Jong
review_text:
A must try in HCM.
Local restaurant with delicious spring roll with grilled meat. Pairedwith vermicelli and crush peanuts for additional texture. Pour some house made fish sauce concoction into your meal and enjoy!

author: Cong He
review_text: We were recommended this spot from our tour guide and its a definite must visit, local vibes with many bike delivery drivers able to ride their bikes into the store to pick up orders. The food was out fast and fresh, the signature BBQ rice noodles were delicious, it had a good portion and the spring roles were cripsy with a generous filling

author: Dana Kizer
review_text: One of our favorite restaurants on our visit to Saigon. The menu is limited but the food is delicious! This is the closest dish to what Americans call vermicelli in the states. A tour guide recommended this restaurant and it did not disappoint. It is extremely casual but the food is excellent. You order at the counter and pay, they give you a sign to put on your table, an employee will get your receipt from you at the table and then bring the food to you. Remember to use this fish sauce. There is a large bucket on each table with small bowls for you to scoop it into. There are also diced peppers on the table to add to it if you like it spicy.

author: Rene Shin
review_text: I think these foods at this price would be perfect for everything. It was really delicious.

author: Carl Shi
review_text:
Great local casual food shop, friendly and helpful staff. The location is in a narrow and very busy street. the BBQ sausage(minced pork) and BBQ pork pieces are quite tasty.  The rice noodles are fresh, the bucket of pre-made fish sauce are just season to taste. Free refill rice noodles which is good for big eaters.
For 30,000 Dung is an absolute bargain! Worth to go and have one.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: SERA RUTH
review_text:
If you're craving authentic Korean cuisine in Ho Chi Minh, look no further than Doran Doran. This charming spot offers a clean and welcoming atmosphere, making it an excellent choice for lunch or dinner. The restaurant is not overly noisy, providing a peaceful and relaxing dining experience.

One standout feature is the precision of their lunch sets, which are well-balanced and satisfying. You’ll get a good variety of dishes that reflect true Korean flavors. The portions are generous and well thought out, perfect for anyone looking to enjoy a fulfilling meal without feeling overwhelmed.

What truly adds to the experience is the hospitality — the boss, a kind Korean person, oversees the restaurant, ensuring everything runs smoothly and guests feel at home. The staff is friendly and attentive, adding to the welcoming vibe of the place.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Sebastian Estores
review_text:
This was soooooo good. Every bonchon was perfect, the bibimbap comes in a hot stone, and everything tastes how it should. No shortcuts in any of the foods they prepared.

I recommend going with many people, as even the lunch set was a LOT of food. The cinnamon dessert was also a really interesting experience.

I could go on and on but just try it. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Jamie Newell
review_text: Super tasty food for a reasonable price. 8 side dishes offered complimentary with the main. Would highly recommend coming!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Huỳnh Lê Thiên Ý
review_text: The atmosphere is super laid-back, and the food is absolutely tasty! Plus, there are endless refills of yummy banchan and free ice cream to enjoy.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Anais Lim
review_text: From the guidance to the seating after entering to the free ice cream dessert at the end, all the food was good. We especially enjoyed the galbi seafood stew. The side dishes were seasoned just right, it was clean, and the staff was friendly, so I had a pleasant dinner.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Võ Ngọc May Thảo
review_text:
Good place to have great time with friends. Korean food is good, perfect service. The owner is really nice and supportive. You will want to return.
Picture is when we finished all. Nothing left.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Philip Hoang
review_text: Love this restaurant. The food is amazing and value for money. They even have free ice cream at the end of the meal, but we were already so full. Also our waiter Nhat Huy was amazing. My mum twisted her ankle earlier in the evening and he was so great and gave us a make shift ice pack so my mum could put it on her ankle. Would recommend this restaurant to anyone.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Oisín Dolan
review_text:
Extremely friendly place. Great food and selection with combos that let you get a few different things to taste. Would be brilliant for a group

Try the cinnamon tea. Never had it before and it's such a nice refreshing sweet end to a meal that won't leave you feeling full

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Michael Ruhwedel
review_text:
We had a fantastic Bibimbap.
The rice was crispy from the hot bowl. Vegetables fresh with very tasty mushrooms. The egg cooked to perfection.
It was the best Bibimbap I had ever eaten.
The appetizers were diverse and very flavorful. The kimchi tasted spicy and extraordinarily well.
The staff provided impeccable service. They were attentive and proud of their restaurant. We were gifted a cold bean sprout soup and mochi ice cream. This left us refreshed and with a feeling of having been very lucky to have found this place.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: YONGJUN SONG (JUN)
review_text: I recently visited this Korean restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, and it was a great experience! The food tasted just like home — especially the kimchi stew and bulgogi, which were both delicious and full of flavor. The staff were friendly and attentive, and the place had a cozy, welcoming vibe. I’ll definitely come back again. Highly recommend if you’re craving authentic Korean food in Vietnam!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Thuy Ly
review_text: One of the best place for cold noodle and bbq in Saigon. I cam here 3 years ago and this time the flavor is still the same 🥰

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Yoon Sung_YS Kim, (YS)
review_text:
Korean restaurant owned and managed by Vietnamese.
1. The taste and services were good enough.
